referee_caveats_inferred: Mixed-quality, heterogeneous archival ALMA/NOEMA/JVLA data; Mdyn from marginally resolved lines with weak inclination constraints
alpha_CO = 0.8 and AGN contribution of 50% to L_IR drive the SFE, depletion time and f_gas conclusions
CO(1-0) luminosity inferred from mid-J via assumed ladder for most targets
Stellar mass from Mdyn-Mgas-MBH with only four targets; f_gas offset sensitive to alpha_CO and to dark matter assumption
SED fitting details inherited from Duras17; no uncertainties on T_dust assumed 60 K for non-Herschel sources

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: tens to a few hundred GB of raw ALMA data across six projects (not counting NOEMA/JVLA)
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA data are public and the main imaging recipe (CASA 5.4.0 tclean, hogbom, natural weighting, 40 km/s channels, uv continuum subtraction) and many numeric results are given, but image/cell sizes, extraction regions, SED fitting details and NOEMA/JVLA data are missing or inherited from other papers.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Only the ALMA part is clearly public, and SED fitting plus inherited recipes and missing imaging parameters prevent a complete standalone redo.
